native_runtime.execution: Actual standalone migration MCP checks, completed before this source capture; sanitized from private logs. No native binary or runtime settings changed during source capture.

native_runtime.snippet: Returned source matched the fixture call

limitations: Instruction reviews are author self-review, not independent behavioral evaluations.
No fresh-model automatic skill routing or compliance test was run.
Native tool behavior does not prove a model read or followed the skill.
No native Windows installation, discovery, or cross-client parity was tested.

static_validation.repository_checks: Passed pre-commit --all-files, plus an explicit --files run for the new untracked bundle, docs and evals.
static_validation.homelab_docs_checks: Passed pre-commit for both changed homelab documentation files.
static_validation.relative_links: 85 relative links in 12 changed Markdown files resolved across both repositories.
static_validation.bundle_integrity: Source, installed tree and deployment manifest contain identical complete file/hash maps.
static_validation.whitespace: Staged git diff --check passed in both repositories. A file-specific .gitattributes exception preserves the reviewed upstream license whitespace byte-for-byte.
static_validation.secret_scan: No new findings. One unchanged preexisting LikeC4 source hash in the deployment manifest was reviewed against HEAD and used as a narrow scan baseline; repository scanner configuration was unchanged.
static_validation.vexp: Verification unavailable because its configured parent workspace is not a Git repository; direct repository checks were used.
